newsitem.title: POLAND: BOMB KILLS MAN, INJURES PASSER-BY IN WARSAW.
newsitem.headline: BOMB KILLS MAN, INJURES PASSER-BY IN WARSAW.

text.p: A bomb planted in an electrical transformer box outside a Warsaw apartment building killed one man and injured a passer-by on Monday, police said.
The blast in the eastern suburb of Praga also damaged several parked cars, a police spokesman told Reuters.
Public television, which identified the dead man only as 29-year-old Artur G., said he had been the target of another attack three months ago.
A Reuter news photographer, who went to the scene, said the victim's hand had been found 100 metres (yards) from the site of the explosion.
Police declined to comment on the likely motive behind the attack.
Dozens of similar blasts each year in Poland are caused by criminal gangs settling scores, fighting each other for dominance or enforcing extortion rackets. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
